name: Badge
summary: A badge is a number pinned to something else, and a number on its own says nothing: 3 is not a count of anything until you say of what. The fix is a few words nobody sees, kept in the badge beside the digits, so the count arrives with its subject attached.
demoNote: Examples 2 to 5 are live. Example 2 prints what four identical-looking badges are read out as; example 3 puts the same badge inside a button and beside it and prints the button's name; example 4 has the badges with no number to read; example 5 counts messages in and logs what a screen reader was handed each time.
